mapper.select: SELECT s.id, a.parking_lot_id, s.area_id, a.area_code, s.space_code, s.description, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM parking_space s JOIN parking_area a ON a.id = s.area_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_space (area_id, space_code, description, status) VALUES (#{areaId}, #{spaceCode}, #{description}, 'FREE')
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_space SET space_code = #{spaceCode}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FREE'
